subject: ACME security discovery — VPC/private deployment & SOC 2 follow-up
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: James Carter <james.carter@acme.com>, Sofia Lopez <sofia.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: ACME security discovery — VPC/private deployment & SOC 2 follow-up

Thanks for the time today — good conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we can move the security review forward on our side.

Recap (from our demo + discovery):
- You’re evaluating Redwood for private deployment (VPC or on-prem) to meet network isolation requirements for several product lines.
- Primary compliance questions: SOC 2 (Type II) status and report availability, GDPR controls, potential HIPAA/BAA needs for a subset of your workloads.
- Your security team prefers a vendor security questionnaire (Excel/OneTrust) and an architectural diagram showing the VPC/topology and any air-gapped/on-prem constraints.

Action items / asks for ACME:
1) SOC 2: can you confirm Type I/Type II and share the latest report or secure link?
2) GDPR / HIPAA: confirm if any workloads will require a BAA; if yes we’ll route to Legal.
3) Architecture: please share a deployment diagram (VPC subnets, NAT/egress, peering, S3 endpoints, kms key flow) — we can review for private deployment fit.
4) Vendor questionnaire: we’ve prepared a short vendor security questionnaire (link below). If you prefer, your security team can provide their standard form.

Proposed next steps:
- If you can share SOC 2 + architecture diagram, I’ll loop Marissa (solutions) and Monica (security/legal ops) to validate architecture and provide canary configuration guidance for private deployments.
- If useful, let’s schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security team next week (I’m available Tue/Wed afternoon PT).

Links/attachments: Vendor questionnaire (short) — https://redwood.inference.com/sq/short-vendor-q

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com | (415) 555-0179

From: James Carter <james.carter@acme.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sofia Lopez <sofia.lopez@acme.com>, security@acme.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME security discovery — VPC/private deployment & SOC 2 follow-up

Marcus — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers inline, and I’ve attached our current VPC diagram for the pilot environment.

1) SOC 2: We have SOC 2 Type II (rolling 12 month). Security will provide a secure link to the report — expect that in 24 hours.
2) GDPR / HIPAA: We are GDPR compliant for customer data. We do not currently process PHI in the service offering for the pilot, but can sign a BAA if you require it for future workloads. Please loop Legal.
3) Architecture: attaching acme-vpc-arch.pdf — shows dedicated VPC, pinned subnets for data processing, egress through a NAT gateway and VPC endpoints for S3. For on-prem air-gapped options, we maintain a separate program — security@acme.com can share constraints.
4) Vendor questionnaire: security@acme.com will start filling this; I’m copying them.

We’re generally comfortable with a private VPC deployment (peered or transit gateway) or an on-prem air-gapped box for regulated customers; we’ll need to validate network egress rules and KMS integration.

Available for a follow-up: Tue 6/23 10:00-11:30 PT or Wed 6/24 13:00-15:00 PT.

Thanks,
James Carter
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme Corp
james.carter@acme.com | +1 213-555-0110

Following up — security team attached the completed vendor questionnaire and a secure link to SOC 2. Note the SOC 2 link expires after 14 days; if you need a permanent copy we can arrange an NDA.

Attachments: acme-vendor-security-answers.xlsx (completed questionnaire)
Secure SOC 2 link: https://onetrust.example.com/s/ACME-SOC2-share

A couple of clarifying notes from security:
- For air-gapped/on-prem, we can support an appliance-based deployment but it requires a maintenance window for occasional updates and a network egress channel for license checks (can be scheduled).
- KMS: we can integrate customer-managed keys; we’ll need an operational runbook for key rotation.
- GDPR: data residency restrictions are limited to EU customers; if you deploy in our EU region we can keep processing and storage within region boundaries.

Happy to join the security sync next Tue 6/23 10:00 PT.

Best —
James
